task.title: T2 Implement the Fix findings action (Review panel → existing Create Flow path) with tests
task.description: Implement plan.md steps 1-4 of flow 522 test-first: pure fixFindingsTarget/fixFindingsPrompt/openFindingCount in apps/desktop/src/reviews/model.ts; a text-labelled 'Fix findings' button in ReviewPanel.tsx; onFixFindings passed through ReviewsView.tsx; App.tsx generalises createPrFlow to take a prompt and wires the Reviews tab handler to it with prSubject(card, repo, repositoryId). Add tests in model.test.ts, ReviewPanel.dom.test.tsx, and App-level coverage (extend apps/desktop/src/test/app-work-row.fixture.tsx run by src/shell/ProjectNavigation.dom.test.tsx, or ReviewsView.dom.test.tsx for the pass-through). Do not change Create Flow's prompt or behaviour.

acceptance_criteria: AC1: `fixFindingsTarget` returns a target only for a Review of the viewer's own open PR (author compared case-insensitively) that is not closed, archived, queued, running or awaiting an answer, has a finished reviewed attempt, and has at least one blocker, major or minor finding; a unit test covers each refusal (other author, closed or merged PR, no card, archived, running, only info findings, no reviewed attempt) and picks the newest unarchived reviewed attempt as the run.

AC2: `fixFindingsPrompt` names the PR URL, the round, the reviewed range, the open counts per severity, says info findings are left out, asks for a Keryx fix flow with flow-orchestrator, and contains the exact `keryx review desk-run status --json --repo … --repository-id … --viewer … --number … --id <runId>` command; a unit test asserts each part.

AC3: The Review panel shows a button with the visible text "Fix findings" only when the Review is eligible and the handler is given; pressing it calls the handler once with the PR card and the prompt; an ineligible Review (other author, only info findings, running) shows no such button. DOM test.

AC4: In the App, Fix findings from the Reviews tab opens the PR's bound session (a new bound one when none exists) with the findings prompt in the composer, not sent, and the one flow package that then appears is offered on the PR's work row as "Link Flow #N" and linked only on Link — the same path as Create Flow. Test through the App fixture or an equivalent App-level DOM test.
AC5: Create Flow on the PR card keeps its prompt and behaviour (existing tests unchanged and green).
AC6: Desktop typecheck passes for the changed files.
constraints: resolved_context_file: .metaproject/flows/522-2026-11-24-desktop-review-v2-fix-findings/resolved/T2.implement.json — read its must_read entries and cite each in project_context_applied; an entry promoted by a condition also needs its anchor and a summary.
